## Problem and change

Explain the concrete problem, the changed behavior, and the affected contract.

## Authority and compatibility

Describe changed input/output schemas, supported semantics, resource behavior,
formal scope, or registered comparison differences. Update the implementation
mapping when sources or responsibilities change. Implementation languages are
unrestricted; an accepting boundary requires an explicit authority declaration.
Reference observations and benchmark results confer no admission authority.
